scope: all same-name variants in corrected UI/item/template intersection
primary_review: Sol directly reviewed fixed Git objects, all tier overrides, actual template bindings, execution-chain applicability and the current player examples.

findings: Six actual trait variants and ten bound marks agree across the frozen UI review, author config, candidate association, and formal compatibility pages. RAW name and description are paired by matching keys, locale 0/16, hashes, and unchanged English source text; tier descriptions agree with each wrapper formatter.

The wrappers use the actual six own tier rows and a one-stack, five-second ProcBuff. The trigger is one completed selected pellet shot, not per pellet; the aggregate all-pellets Boolean and the separately supplied attacked_unit/minion check can diverge for multi-target penetration. Single-target examples state their alignment premise.

Both double-shot P2 modes fire a 32-pellet shell through one shoot_pellets action and one aggregate event after the selected shot, not one event per barrel. Load/toggle/flashlight actions do not themselves count as a completed shot; actual follow-up shots use the verified route.

The direct pellet damage resolves before the on_shoot proc is queued, so the triggering shot does not retroactively receive the new bonus. The held condition controls the contribution after cache update; the five-second timer continues through weapon switching and true source-item removal ends the blessing.

For bound shotgun_p1_m3 only, the burning special applies flamer_assault after pellet hits; later 0.5-second ticks use the owner/source weapon and live tick-time stats. This is conditional on Full Bore already being processed, the attribute cache updated, and the source weapon still held; it is not a firing-time power snapshot.

For shotpistol_shield_p1_m1, pure shield push is not the shoot_pellets trigger. Its generic power can feed impact/stagger calculation while the push profile has zero health damage; the fixed 20 only applies to the documented shield reaction branch and is not claimed as every final stagger result.
The original icon is actual item.icon weapon_trait_132 and matches the attached/publicly verified 128px receipt; no image substitution is present.
